title: Egress control-plane ruleset store
description: The control plane's entire internal state, in a SINGLE blob (egress-config/rulesets.json). It is NOT what the proxy reads: the control plane renders this document into allowlist.json, whose schema is frozen (see allowlist.schema.json). Written only by the control-plane API's identity; the grants section is platform-owned and the API never modifies it.

grants.description: Platform-owned RBAC: which identities hold onboard/update/offboard. Edited by the platform team out of band; read-only to the API, which splices it through every write untouched.

fallback.description: Platform-owned baseline for sources matching no ruleset. Rendered through to allowlist.json unchanged. If omitted or empty, fallback is deny-all.

name.description: Unique slug; the ruleset's identity in the API path and the rendered module id.

subjects.description: The workload identities this ruleset governs. Write-once at onboard; a subject belongs to at most one ruleset.

owner.description: Identity recorded trust-on-first-use at onboard; holds update/offboard on this ruleset.

subject.description: Exactly one of appid (managed-identity client ID, the token-mode key) or netid (source CIDR, the netid-mode key).

content.description: The writable part of a ruleset: what update replaces, in full.

action.description: Uniform across the whole ruleset. Forced to report at onboard; never downgraded by the control plane afterwards.

acl.description: Reserved for the management portal (Mode 3). Not consulted by the Mode 2 write path, which authorizes against the platform RBAC grants plus TOFU ownership.

identity.description: The caller's appid/azp claim — a pipeline service-connection identity, never a governed workload.

rulesets.description: Scopes update/offboard to these ruleset names. Omitted means every ruleset — platform-team grants only. Never scopes onboard, which is registry-wide by nature (the ruleset does not exist yet).

note.description: Free text for the platform team; ignored by the API.
